comment: Corpus manifest for scc-bench. The synthetic sequences listed
below are GENERATED at run-time from the seed; they are not
checked into git -- their bytes are reproducible from the seed.
External corpora (NYUv2 subset, BigBIRD subset) are referenced
with download URLs and SHA-256 sums; they are downloaded on
first use and never committed. CI runs against the synthetic
set only -- zero network during bench in PR runs.

synthetic.name: moving_plane
synthetic.description: Tilted plane translating across the FOV; tests temporal coding.

synthetic.name: static_room
synthetic.description: Static room geometry plus per-pixel sensor noise; tests spatial + noise robustness.

synthetic.name: textured_sphere
synthetic.description: Sphere with high-frequency texture noise; tests non-planar smooth-surface coding.
